aes cases: the seven columns become control[0..4] and int_in

aes cases: a malformed line is an error, never a skipped case
aes cases: the comment is everything from column seven on
aes cases: a "+" line is a prelude, carries no case id
aes cases: the CRC covers the raw file, comments included
aes cases: opcodes that stop the run finishing are refused

a present 0xFFFFFFFF is not absent: the high half is 0
